warden.name: Mara Venn
warden.signature: Guards allies, then punishes pressure at the front.
warden.weakness: Most defining actions fail from the back ranks.
warden.summary: Durable frontliner who guards allies and controls enemy ranks.

engineer.name: Ivo Senn
engineer.signature: Turns marks and formation changes into energy and protection.
engineer.strength: Excellent hand, energy, and rank correction.
engineer.weakness: Loses its strongest tools when forced to rank 1.
engineer.summary: Flexible controller who moves combatants and manipulates energy.

medic.name: Dr. Orra Vale
medic.signature: Repairs health, stress, wounds, and Death's Door crises.
medic.strength: Best direct recovery and emergency stabilization.
medic.weakness: Low damage makes slow fights increasingly dangerous.
medic.summary: Dedicated recovery specialist for health, stress, and emergencies.

scout.name: Kei Rook
scout.signature: Marks any target, cycles the hand, and fires from the back.
scout.strength: Wide target reach and high marked-target burst.
scout.weakness: Forward displacement disables its best shots.
scout.summary: Mobile backliner who marks targets and cycles through the deck.

breacher.name: Dax Rell
breacher.signature: Crashes into point-blank range and scatters the enemy line.
breacher.weakness: Recoil and self-stress demand formation support.
breacher.summary: Explosive front-rank attacker with burst damage and forced movement.

psion.name: Nia Voss
psion.signature: Reorders and disables enemies while gambling with stress.
psion.weakness: Fragile, stress-hungry, and weak when pulled forward.
psion.summary: Fragile control specialist who trades stress for stuns and disruption.

quartermaster.name: Bram Coil
quartermaster.signature: Smooths the shared hand and distributes scarce protection.
quartermaster.strength: Makes expensive and mixed-owner decks more consistent.
quartermaster.weakness: Adds little burst pressure without allied finishers.
quartermaster.summary: Card-economy support who distributes protection and extra actions.

operative.name: Sable Kade
operative.signature: Creates or cashes marks, then vanishes before retaliation.
operative.strength: Precise payoff damage against priority targets.
operative.weakness: Needs setup and safe back ranks for peak output.
operative.summary: Precise mobile assassin who exploits marks and vulnerable targets.

biologist.name: Dr. Yara Moss
biologist.signature: Cultivates wounds, then converts them into damage or recovery.
biologist.weakness: Slow setup can lose races against immediate pressure.
biologist.summary: Attrition specialist using wounds, weakness, and regenerative support.

synth.name: Unit Lumen
synth.signature: Anchors the line while charging flexible hardlight actions.
synth.strength: Reliable defense, guard, and energy support.
synth.weakness: Card draw can outpace the party's shared energy.
synth.summary: Resilient energy support with hardlight defenses and reliable control.

duelist.name: Tal Ren
duelist.signature: Evades a committed attack and answers it with a riposte.
duelist.weakness: Wide attacks and enemy backliners bypass its duel.
duelist.summary: Mobile counterattacker who evades single hits and punishes direct attackers.

artillerist.name: Mox Calder
artillerist.signature: Turns setup and stress into formation-wide bombardment.
artillerist.weakness: Fragile and nearly inert when dragged to the front.
artillerist.summary: Fragile backliner who trades stress and setup for heavy bursts and volleys.

chaplain.name: Sister Ilex
chaplain.signature: Absorbs dread while cleansing and focusing the whole crew.
chaplain.weakness: Protective turns rely on allies to finish threats.
chaplain.summary: Morale support who cleanses ailments, inspires allies, and accepts stress for them.

hacker.name: Pax Null
hacker.signature: Edits enemy states while filtering the shared hand.
hacker.strength: Strong debuffs, setup, and card-flow control.
hacker.weakness: Low durability and poor function from rank 1.
hacker.summary: Disruption specialist who marks, weakens, and jams hostile action loops.

pilot.name: Oren Pike
pilot.signature: Steers specialists into position and hostile ranks out of it.
pilot.weakness: Movement without the right partners wastes tempo.
pilot.summary: Formation support who steers allies and enemies while granting evasive cover.

cryonaut.name: Eira Glace
cryonaut.signature: Freezes exposed targets while preserving endangered allies.
cryonaut.strength: Combines control with resilient rescue tools.
cryonaut.weakness: Area attacks are costly and immediate damage is modest.
cryonaut.summary: Cryogenic defender who slows pressure with blocks, weakness, and emergency preservation.

horticulturist.name: Sol Briar
horticulturist.signature: Grows wounds into a network of thorns and recovery.
horticulturist.weakness: Needs time or wound setup before it becomes efficient.
horticulturist.summary: Hydroponic support who grows protection while rooting and wearing down hostiles.

foundryman.name: Hark Vela
foundryman.signature: Tempers stress into armor and devastating close strikes.
foundryman.weakness: Heat-driven stress becomes dangerous without relief.
foundryman.summary: Foundry bruiser who converts heat and stress into armor and close-range force.

reactor_saint.name: Saint Cira
reactor_saint.signature: Escalates critical energy while containing its stress fallout.
reactor_saint.strength: Flexible energy, marks, wounds, and party defense.
reactor_saint.weakness: Repeated rites can trigger an affliction spiral.
reactor_saint.summary: Volatile reactor mystic balancing party protection against radiation-scarred aggression.

mycologist.name: Miko Spore
mycologist.signature: Links wounded enemies and allies through restorative spores.
mycologist.strength: Efficient attrition support and group cleansing.
mycologist.weakness: Limited burst and vulnerable to forward displacement.
mycologist.summary: Fungal medic spreading restorative networks and debilitating spores across formations.

diver.name: Neris Drown
diver.signature: Uses pressure and lifelines to drag both formations forward.
diver.strength: Strong line manipulation and stress protection.
diver.weakness: Cannot pressure enemy back ranks without setup.
diver.summary: Flooded-zone controller using pressure, ballast, and harpoons to rearrange combat.

stormcaller.name: Vey Ion
stormcaller.signature: Chains marked targets into energy and reactive lightning.
stormcaller.strength: Fast setup, wide reach, and explosive tempo.
stormcaller.weakness: Fragile and dependent on protected back ranks.
stormcaller.summary: Storm-channeling striker with chain attacks, reactive guards, and formation disruption.

archivist.name: Ada Quill
archivist.signature: Catalogs targets while revising draws and discards.
archivist.weakness: Very poor access to defining cards from the front.
archivist.summary: Archive tactician who marks priority records and restores allies from impossible ledgers.

voidwalker.name: Oss Null
voidwalker.signature: Trades stress and position to expose impossible openings.
voidwalker.strength: Exceptional formation control and emergency evasion.
voidwalker.weakness: Risk costs compound quickly without stabilization.
voidwalker.summary: Risk-heavy void adept who bends enemy ranks and exposes targets through absence.

bonewright.name: Tern Ivory
bonewright.signature: Builds protection from wounds and near-death emergencies.
bonewright.strength: Durable guarding and Death's Door stabilization.
bonewright.weakness: Short attack reach and modest tempo when nobody is hurt.
bonewright.summary: Ossuary guardian who builds durable scaffolds and splints from battlefield remains.

bulkhead_basics.name: Bulkhead Basics
bulkhead_basics.playstyle: Defend, mark a priority target, and convert that setup into efficient damage.
bulkhead_basics.strength: Clear roles, dependable recovery, and answers from every rank.
bulkhead_basics.weakness: Modest area damage makes crowded fights slower.
bulkhead_basics.signature: Scout marks targets for the Engineer while the Warden protects the Medic.

breach_protocol.name: Breach Protocol
breach_protocol.playstyle: Break enemy order, build marks, and spend the resulting tempo on aggressive turns.
breach_protocol.strength: Strong card flow, formation control, and front-rank burst.
breach_protocol.weakness: Limited direct healing makes damage stick between fights.
breach_protocol.signature: Hacker marks openings; Breacher and Synth exploit them.

wound_ward.name: Wound Ward
wound_ward.playstyle: Spread wounds across both formations, then turn them into healing, block, and finishers.
wound_ward.strength: Excellent attrition, rescue tools, and enemy-rank control.
wound_ward.weakness: Setup-heavy opening turns can fall behind immediate pressure.
wound_ward.signature: Biologist grows wounds that power Mycologist and Bonewright.

static_choir.name: Static Choir
static_choir.playstyle: Reposition constantly, evade retaliation, and convert stress into precise bombardment.
static_choir.strength: Flexible movement, morale control, and strong reach.
static_choir.weakness: Bad movement strands the Artillerist or wastes counters.
static_choir.signature: Pilot fixes ranks; Chaplain absorbs the Artillerist's stress.

unstable_research.name: Unstable Research
unstable_research.playstyle: Accept stress and positional risk to chain control, energy, and vulnerable payoffs.
unstable_research.strength: Powerful control and explosive conditional turns.
unstable_research.weakness: Stress compounds; poor sequencing can break formation.
unstable_research.signature: Cryonaut control buys time for reactor and void payoffs.

marked_vector.name: Marked Vector
marked_vector.playstyle: Establish a marked target, cash it from two ranks, then rotate the back line.
marked_vector.strength: Dense mark production and precise payoff reach.
marked_vector.weakness: Unmarked crowds blunt the squad's best damage.
marked_vector.signature: Scout and Operative expose a target for Engineer feedback.

scar_garden.name: Scar Garden
scar_garden.playstyle: Seed wounds, shelter the slow setup, then harvest attrition as block and healing.
scar_garden.strength: Deep wound production with several salvage conversions.
scar_garden.weakness: Immediate burst races arrive before the garden matures.
scar_garden.signature: Biologist and Horticulturist feed Mycologist's wound network.

countercurrent.name: Countercurrent
countercurrent.playstyle: Dance through ranks while riposte and artillery punish the openings.
countercurrent.strength: Exceptional formation repair and back-rank reach.
countercurrent.weakness: An unnecessary move can disable the next owner's card.
countercurrent.signature: Pilot routes Duelist counters around a protected cannon.

signal_lock.name: Signal Lock
signal_lock.playstyle: Displace and disable threats while a guarded backline builds a storm payoff.
signal_lock.strength: Layered control, guard, and wide-rank answers.
signal_lock.weakness: Lower direct damage makes cleansers and healers urgent.
signal_lock.signature: Diver pulls targets into Cryonaut and Stormcaller control.

discard_cell.name: Discard Cell
discard_cell.playstyle: Cycle the shared hand aggressively and turn discarded options into tempo.
discard_cell.strength: High draw velocity finds positional answers quickly.
discard_cell.weakness: Over-cycling burns setup cards before their payoffs arrive.
discard_cell.signature: Quartermaster and Archivist filter cards for Breacher bursts.

last_lantern.name: Last Lantern
last_lantern.playstyle: Stabilize Death's Door, protect a fragile rear, and remain functional after loss.
last_lantern.strength: Many crisis answers and strong casualty recovery.
last_lantern.weakness: Healthy turns are slower and offer modest pressure.
last_lantern.signature: Bonewright buys time for Medic and Chaplain rescue lines.

reactor_broadside.name: Reactor Broadside
reactor_broadside.playstyle: Mark the line, absorb recoil, and fire costly attacks across every hostile rank.
reactor_broadside.strength: Spectacular area pressure with mark and energy bridges.
reactor_broadside.weakness: Rank disruption and stress can silence both rear strikers.
reactor_broadside.signature: Reactor energy drives Stormcaller arcs and Artillerist volleys.

after_action.name: After Action
after_action.playstyle: Push early tempo, then convert a casualty or crisis into a controlled recovery.
after_action.strength: Balanced burst, hand control, healing, and post-loss play.
after_action.weakness: The doctrine taxes the first turns while everyone survives.
after_action.signature: Quartermaster keeps Medic rescue and Operative payoff cards moving.

reactor_breaker.name: Reactor Breaker Bank
